propositions: code_health metric is currently Python-only and cannot be used by non-Python client projects
rebar core must have zero new hard dependencies; analyzer tools must be optional via [metrics] extra
missing analyzer or language support must emit Unavailable with clear reason, never fabricate zeros or leak exceptions
analyzer interface must compute loc, complexity, and duplication deterministically via scc/lizard/jscpd without network or LLM
module-size policy must be per-project config, not hardcoded to rebar governance artifacts
code_health must work for both Python and non-Python projects (e.g. Go, TypeScript)
